faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common inquiries about licensing, trial tests, and training requirements in Nepal.
faq.q1: What documents are required to apply for a driving license in Nepal?
faq.a1: You need an original Nepali Citizenship Certificate (Nagarikta), passport-sized photographs, blood group test report, and medical vision clearance report.
faq.q2: What is the pass criteria for the DoTM 70-point trial system?
faq.a2: Under Nepal's trial assessment system, applicants need a minimum of 70 points out of 100 to pass. Minor errors (such as one foot touch on figure 8) carry point deductions without immediate failure.
faq.q3: Can I choose my daily practice time slot?
faq.a3: Yes, we offer flexible training shifts throughout the day so students and working professionals can practice at convenient hours.
